title: Home's model tools run live, and every live and eval run is collected for the six models
request: The owner: 'make sure collect all data of these test and live tests for training data all 6 model'; English first. The new model tools (query_data, propose_step, compare_periods) had never run live: Home's rules had answered first.
spec: A capped live probe of English requests worded so the rules cannot read them; every kept run in a layout the store collects as conversations, with a ledger beside it for the decision models.
plan: A probe of six dev requests, every Home model client capped together, drafts and a ledger kept.
Find why kept eval runs were not collected as conversations; fix the layout; move the existing runs.
Run the store and check the sets.

decisions.decision: The kept runs are moved into a drafts/ folder, never copied or deleted.
decisions.why: The store reads a workspace by its layout; moving keeps one copy of each conversation and loses nothing.

decisions.decision: The probe installs its own ledger in the kept folder.
decisions.why: A bare draft store records no decision; the decision models (m1 to m3) need Home's decisions with their labels.

change: The Home tools probe (new); the Home eval keeps each live case's drafts in a drafts folder with a ledger beside it; its test; the existing kept eval runs moved into that layout (the store's files, not committed).

findings.defect: Live and eval conversations never reached the conversation sets.
findings.scenario: HOME-008 and HOME-010 kept 53 drafts of Home with Claude, with thinking; none was a conversation example.
findings.cause: They were kept one folder per case with each draft directly inside, with no drafts folder, so the store filed them as test files, which the conversation builder never reads.
findings.fix: Each case's drafts are kept in a drafts folder (a workspace's layout), with a ledger of its decisions beside it; the existing runs moved.

measurements.name: The model tools, live (English, Claude)
measurements.gate: each tool reached and its result given to the person
measurements.result: Two analysis questions answered from the model's query plans; two preparation requests prepared through propose_step (two steps each); two business questions briefed through compare_periods (the rewording kept the template: it did not pass the checks); 8 of 20 model calls carried thinking text
limits: six requests; a check that the paths work live, not a score

outcome: Every Home model tool now works live with Claude, and every live and eval run's conversations, decisions and thinking reach the store for the six models.
lessons: Capture is only real if the collector reads it: check where a kept file lands, not only that it was written.
risks: Eval runs' persons are scripted ('I'm not sure'): marked as scripted, never a human's answer.
